# Document templates

The four `.docx` files in this directory are the shipping templates the
"New from template" picker offers. They are generated by a Go program
that hands a ProseMirror JSON tree to the same `translate.PMJSONToDocx`
pipeline a normal save uses — every template ships through the exact
code path the editor would on a normal round-trip.

The bytes are committed so reviewers can open them in Word to
spot-check, and so a Go-side test can re-parse each file to confirm it
round-trips cleanly. The client never reads from disk: the same Go
program also emits `tinycld/text/lib/templates/templates.generated.ts`,
which embeds each file as a base64 string so Metro doesn't need to
register `.docx` as an asset extension.

## Regenerate

From the package root (`text/`):

```sh
go run ./server/cmd/gen-templates
```

Or, if you're already inside `server/`:

```sh
go run ./cmd/gen-templates
```

The command writes:

- `tinycld/text/assets/templates/<id>.docx` — one per template
- `tinycld/text/lib/templates/templates.generated.ts` — base64 bundle

Both outputs are committed. Re-run after editing
`server/cmd/gen-templates/main.go` (where the PM JSON for each template
lives) and review the resulting `.docx` files before committing.
